lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Government command lance at the northern cut. They followed the witness convoy.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we hold the entrance. We are done trading people for our escape.

lines.speaker: saldana
lines.text: Both transports are inside. The wounded are stable.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: People are asking where to build bunks.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: The broadcast calls this a terrorist compound.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: It is not a hiding place anymore. It is a base.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Authorities have identified an extremist network led by traitor Commander Vale.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: They gave us a name before we chose one.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we choose what it means. We protect people, preserve the truth, and fight back from here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: End of Prototype — Act One complete.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: The entrance is collapsing. Pull back and reset the defense before they reach the transports.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Government command frame visible. Missile carrier behind it, drone on support.

midBattle.speaker: nyx
midBattle.text: That commander will mark targets for the whole line. Break its coordination.

midBattle.speaker: civilian
midBattle.text: Commander Vale—Hollowmere remembers what your squad did.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Transport armor failing at the quarry mouth. I need a body between it and the missiles!

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: They expected fugitives. Show them people defending a home.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Quarry holds. Get everyone inside—we build from here.
